assignment_rationale: Collapse all Turkey earthquake source directories into one real-disaster event group.
Collapse current rwanda_volcano and BRIGHT congo-volcano into the Nyiragongo 2021 event group.
Move the complete Turkey event group to train so train retains earthquake coverage while val and test remain balanced at 290 current samples each.
Keep every event_group_id in exactly one split and preserve the former strict-v1 split in directory_split_v1 for historical traceability.
Treat the resulting test as historically observed rather than a pristine untouched final test because earlier work inspected the source test events.

excluded_source_events.congo-volcano: event group reserved for test and aliases current rwanda_volcano
excluded_source_events.la_palma-volcano: does not improve damaged/destroyed event-class support after deduplication
excluded_source_events.turkey-earthquake: same real disaster spans former strict-v1 train/val/test directories

evaluation_status.event_group_v1_test: historically observed diagnostic test; not pristine unseen-disaster evidence
